cdf:Profile.cdf:title: Missing Updates
cdf:Profile.cdf:description: This profile contains a rule for checking for missing updates

cdf:Profile.cdf:title: All Updates
cdf:Profile.cdf:description: This profile contains a rule that reports on all updates, failing those that are missing

cdf:Rule.cdf:title: Check system for missing Windows Updates
cdf:Rule.cdf:description: The OVAL scanner deterines if Windows Update should be queried via the Internet, or WSUS, or via offline wsusscn2.cab file, refer to application documentation on how to configure which method to use.
cdf:Rule.cdf:fixtext: Update computer with the latest approved updates from Microsoft

cdf:Rule.cdf:title: Check system for all Windows Updates, reporting failures on any not installed
cdf:Rule.cdf:description: The OVAL scanner deterines if Windows Update should be queried via the Internet, or WSUS, or via offline wsusscn2.cab file, refer to application documentation on how to configure which method to use.
cdf:Rule.cdf:fixtext: Update computer with the latest approved updates from Microsoft
